name: SCRIPT_COMMAND_TALK
help: The resulting source says, yells or whispers a text from broadcast_text to the resulting target (the chat type comes from the broadcast_text entry). If more texts are given, one is chosen at random. Alternatively, a random template can pick the text from dbscript_random_templates.
search_tags: talk say yell whisper text broadcast

name: SCRIPT_COMMAND_EMOTE
help: The resulting source plays an emote. If more emotes are given, one is chosen at random.

name: SCRIPT_COMMAND_FIELD_SET
help: Sets a raw update field of the source object to the given value. Advanced — prefer a dedicated command when one exists.

name: SCRIPT_COMMAND_MOVE_TO
help: The resulting source moves to the given position. Special cases: if X/Y/Z are all 0 (or the source is already at the point), only the facing is set to O; if only Z is set, the source moves vertically by Z. When the movement finishes, the relay script is started. Speed 0 uses the default speed.
search_tags: move goto position point walk teleport respawn home

variants.description: {source}: Move its creature group members to their home positions

name: SCRIPT_COMMAND_FLAG_SET
help: ORs the bitmask into a raw update field of the source object. Advanced — prefer 'Modify NPC flags' or 'Modify unit flags' when possible.

name: SCRIPT_COMMAND_FLAG_REMOVE
help: Clears the bitmask from a raw update field of the source object. Advanced — prefer 'Modify NPC flags' or 'Modify unit flags' when possible.

name: SCRIPT_COMMAND_TELEPORT_TO
help: Teleports the player (taken from target or source) to the given map and position.

name: SCRIPT_COMMAND_QUEST_EXPLORED
help: Gives 'exploration or event' credit for the quest to the player (source or target); the other side must be a creature or gameobject. If a distance is given and the player is farther away — or the credit-giving creature is dead — the quest is failed instead. Distance 0 disables the distance check; otherwise it must be between interaction distance (~5) and visibility distance (90).
search_tags: quest explored credit event complete area
description: Give player explored credit for quest {Quest}

name: SCRIPT_COMMAND_KILL_CREDIT
help: Gives kill credit for a creature entry to the player (source or target). Entry 0 uses the entry of the participating creature. Group credit rewards the player's whole group.

name: SCRIPT_COMMAND_RESPAWN_GAMEOBJECT
help: Respawns a gameobject, either by its spawn guid or the buddy/source gameobject. For gameobjects that are not spawned by default, the despawn delay (seconds) sets how long it stays. Doors, fishing nodes and fishing holes are not supported.

name: SCRIPT_COMMAND_TEMP_SPAWN_CREATURE
help: Summons a creature at the given position. With despawn delay 0 it despawns only when dead, otherwise after the delay (out of combat) or on death. Optionally a waypoint path id, run mode and a creature_spawn_data_template entry can be given.

variants.description: Summon creature {Creature} at ({X}, {Y}, {Z}) as active object

name: SCRIPT_COMMAND_OPEN_DOOR
help: Opens a door or button gameobject, by its spawn guid or the buddy/source gameobject. It closes again automatically after the reset delay (seconds, minimum 15). If the script target is a button, that button is toggled too.

name: SCRIPT_COMMAND_CLOSE_DOOR
help: Closes a door or button gameobject, by its spawn guid or the buddy/source gameobject. It opens again automatically after the reset delay (seconds, minimum 15). If the script target is a button, that button is toggled too.

name: SCRIPT_COMMAND_ACTIVATE_OBJECT
help: The source unit uses the target gameobject. With the additional flag, a custom animation is played on the gameobject instead.

name: SCRIPT_COMMAND_REMOVE_AURA
help: Removes an aura from the resulting source. Mode selects whether the whole aura, one charge or one stack is removed. The additional flag (whole aura only) removes just the auras cast by the script target.
search_tags: remove aura spell dispel charge stack

variants.name_readable: Remove aura cast by script target

name: SCRIPT_COMMAND_CAST_SPELL
help: The resulting source casts the spell at the resulting target. If random spells are given, one is chosen at random (equally chanced with the main spell). Script casts never trigger procs. With the additional flag the spell is cast without a target.

name: SCRIPT_COMMAND_PLAY_SOUND
help: Plays a sound from the source. The flags control who hears it: 'only to target player' and 'distance dependent' can be combined, but not with the map/zone/area-wide flags. For zone/area wide, the zone or area id can be set explicitly, otherwise the source's current one is used. With the additional flag, music is played instead of a sound.

name: SCRIPT_COMMAND_CREATE_ITEM
help: Gives the item to the player (source or target). With the additional flag, the item is taken from the player instead.

name: SCRIPT_COMMAND_DESPAWN_SELF
help: Despawns the resulting target creature after the delay. Older scripts that only set a creature source keep working, but should use the self-targeting data flag instead.

name: SCRIPT_COMMAND_PLAY_MOVIE
help: Plays a movie (cinematic) for the target player.

name: SCRIPT_COMMAND_MOVEMENT
help: Changes the movement generator of the resulting source creature. Skipped while the source is in combat. Each movement type uses different parameters — pick a variant. For random movement the additional flag wanders around the current position instead of the respawn position.
search_tags: movement idle random waypoint path linear jump fall generator

name: SCRIPT_COMMAND_SET_ACTIVEOBJECT
help: Toggles the 'active' state of the resulting source. Active objects keep their grid loaded and updated even with no players nearby. Not usable on players.

name: SCRIPT_COMMAND_SET_FACTION
help: Sets a temporary faction on the resulting source creature; faction 0 restores the default one. The flags control when the original faction is restored automatically (without any flag the change persists until changed manually).

name: SCRIPT_COMMAND_MORPH_TO_ENTRY_OR_MODEL
help: Morphs the resulting source creature into the model of the given creature entry (or a display id directly, with the additional flag). Entry/model 0 demorphs.

name: SCRIPT_COMMAND_MOUNT_TO_ENTRY_OR_MODEL
help: Mounts the resulting source creature on the model of the given creature entry (or a display id directly, with the additional flag). Entry/model 0 dismounts. With 'Apply mount speed' set, the mount's speed from the creature template is applied too.

name: SCRIPT_COMMAND_SET_RUN
help: Switches the resulting source creature between running and walking.

name: SCRIPT_COMMAND_ATTACK_START
help: The resulting source creature starts attacking the resulting target unit (if it can attack it right now).

name: SCRIPT_COMMAND_GO_LOCK_STATE
help: Locks/unlocks the resulting source gameobject and/or makes it (non-)interactable. Lock and unlock are mutually exclusive, as are the two interactable flags.

name: SCRIPT_COMMAND_STAND_STATE
help: Sets the stand state (stand, sit, sleep, kneel, ...) of the resulting source creature.

name: SCRIPT_COMMAND_MODIFY_NPC_FLAGS
help: Adds, removes or toggles NPC flags (gossip, questgiver, vendor, ...) on the resulting source creature.

name: SCRIPT_COMMAND_SEND_TAXI_PATH
help: Puts the player (source or target) on the given taxi path. Taxi paths that can already be triggered by a spell are rejected at load time.
description: Send player on taxi path {Taxi path}

name: SCRIPT_COMMAND_TERMINATE_SCRIPT
help: Terminates the remaining steps of this script. If a search entry or pool id is given, termination depends on finding a matching alive creature (or gameobject, with the buddy-by-GO flag) within the search distance: by default the script terminates when it is NOT found; with the additional flag, when it IS found. On termination, the wait time of the source's current waypoint can additionally be changed by the given amount (ms).

variants.description: Terminate script if {Search creature} is found within {Search distance} yd

name: SCRIPT_COMMAND_PAUSE_WAYPOINTS
help: Pauses or unpauses the waypoint movement of the resulting source creature.

name: SCRIPT_COMMAND_XP_USER
help: Enables or disables experience gain for the player (source or target).

name: SCRIPT_COMMAND_TERMINATE_COND
help: Terminates the remaining steps of this script when the conditions-table entry is satisfied (or, with the additional flag, when it is NOT satisfied). If a fail quest is set, that quest is failed for the player and their group members when the script terminates.

name: SCRIPT_COMMAND_SEND_AI_EVENT
help: The resulting source creature sends an AI event. With a radius, it is sent to all friendly creatures around; with radius 0 and a creature target, it is sent directly to the target; between a creature and a player it is delivered to the creature side directly.
description: {source}: Send AI event {AI event type} to {target}

name: SCRIPT_COMMAND_SET_FACING
help: Turns the resulting source creature towards the resulting target. With 'Reset facing' set, the source instead turns back to its default orientation (movement reset position or respawn orientation).

name: SCRIPT_COMMAND_MOVE_DYNAMIC
help: Moves the resulting source creature relative to the resulting target. With max distance 0, the source moves into contact with the target (at the fixed distance, if given). Otherwise it moves to a random point between min and max distance around the target; if O is set, the point is taken in that direction (with the additional flag, relative to the target's current orientation). When the movement finishes, the relay script is started. Skipped while the source is in combat.
search_tags: move dynamic random around target approach

name: SCRIPT_COMMAND_SEND_MAIL
help: Sends a mail from a mail template to the target player, optionally with money attached and delivery delayed by the given number of seconds. The sender is the source creature, or the alternative sender creature entry if given.

name: SCRIPT_COMMAND_SET_HOVER
help: Enables or disables hovering (and levitation) on the resulting source creature. With the additional flag, the hover animation byte flag is set/removed too.

name: SCRIPT_COMMAND_DESPAWN_GO
help: Despawns the resulting target gameobject after the delay.

name: SCRIPT_COMMAND_RESPAWN
help: Respawns the resulting target creature. To find a dead or despawned creature buddy, enable the 'buddy is dead or despawned' flag.

name: SCRIPT_COMMAND_SET_EQUIPMENT_SLOTS
help: Overrides the visible equipment (weapons) of the resulting source creature with the given item entries; 0 clears a slot. 'Reset to default' reloads the equipment template from creature_template instead.

name: SCRIPT_COMMAND_RESET_GO
help: Resets the resulting target gameobject to its ready state. Only works on doors and buttons.

name: SCRIPT_COMMAND_UPDATE_TEMPLATE
help: Changes the creature entry (template) of the resulting source creature. Skipped if it already has that entry.

name: SCRIPT_COMMAND_START_RELAY_SCRIPT
help: Starts a dbscripts_on_relay script with the current source and target. If a random template is given, the relay script is picked from dbscript_random_templates (type 1) instead of the fixed relay id.

name: SCRIPT_COMMAND_CAST_CUSTOM_SPELL
help: The resulting source casts the spell at the resulting target with the effect base points overridden by the given values. At least one base points value must be non-zero. Note: the value is used as-is (a value of 1 means the effect value is 1).
search_tags: cast custom spell basepoints bp value

name: SCRIPT_COMMAND_INTERRUPT_SPELL
help: Interrupts the spell the resulting source is currently casting in the given cast slot.

name: SCRIPT_COMMAND_MODIFY_UNIT_FLAGS
help: Adds, removes or toggles unit flags on the resulting source creature.

name: SCRIPT_COMMAND_SET_DATA_64
help: Calls SetData64 on the instance script of the source's map. Only useful on maps with an instance script. Advanced.

name: SCRIPT_COMMAND_ZONE_PULSE
help: Puts the resulting source creature in combat with the whole zone and makes it attack the closest enemy.

name: SCRIPT_COMMAND_SPAWN_GROUP
help: Controls spawn-group formations. The target creature must be in (or lead) the affected formation; for create/remove, spawn group 0 uses the target's own creature group. Spread must be between 0.5 and 15. Pick a variant for the specific subcommand.
search_tags: spawn group formation shape spread options

variants.description: {target}: Create formation for spawn group {Spawn group}
{target}: Remove formation from spawn group {Spawn group}

name: SCRIPT_COMMAND_SET_GOSSIP_MENU
help: Sets a new default gossip menu id on the resulting target creature.

name: SCRIPT_COMMAND_SET_WORLDSTATE
help: Sets a map-scoped worldstate variable to a new value. The worldstate id must be a named worldstate known to the core.

name: SCRIPT_COMMAND_SET_SHEATHE
help: Sets the sheathe state (unarmed / melee weapon / ranged weapon) of the resulting source unit.

name: SCRIPT_COMMAND_SET_STRING_ID
help: Applies or removes a string_id on the resulting source world object. String ids are named tags that scripts and the core can use to find objects.
search_tags: string id set apply remove tag

name: SCRIPT_COMMAND_RECALL_OR_RESPAWN_ACCESSORIES
help: Recalls (searches within the given radius) and/or respawns the accessories of the source vehicle. Seat index -1 affects all seats.
search_tags: vehicle accessories recall respawn passenger seat
description: {source}: {Mode} vehicle accessories {Seat index:choose(-1):in all seats|in seat {Seat index}}{Mode:choose(2):| in {Recall radius} yd}

name: SCRIPT_COMMAND_SET_ANIM_TIER
help: Sets the animation tier (ground / swim / hover / fly / submerged) of the resulting source unit.
search_tags: anim tier animation hover fly ground
